text:
nisha_r: Heads-up: product wants to make v2 the default for new tenants next week. Need quick ops checklist (telemetry, pin escape, billing UX).
ben_t: Quick list: header escape hatch, console pin, shadow checks, estimated cost before pin.
oli_v: Header idea: `X-Redwood-Client-Version: v1` with precedence: header > tenant_pin > default.
ben_t: Telemetry: add `version_hint`, `routing_decision`, `pin_state`, `shadow_score` tags. Sample rate default 0.5%. bump to 5% on regression.
nisha_r: Shadow suite: 20 canonical prompts per tenant, nightly run for pinned tenants. if regression_score > 0.2 for 3 nights -> page.
oli_v: Pin TTL: 30 days by default, editable. Console shows estimated percent cost change and last shadow_score. RBAC: admins-only.
ben_t: Billing: bill for served model variant. Console must show clear estimate and safety cap option to auto-unpin if spend rises >25%.
nisha_r: Routing impl: memcache key `rw_pin:{tenant}:{route}:{region}:{pin_ver}`. TTL 15s; pin_ver increments on change.
oli_v: Multi-region note: pin state should be authoritative and globally consistent for billing.
ben_t: Rollout: 5% new tenants -> monitor 7 days -> 25% -> 100% after 30d if OK.
deploy-bot: job created: `v2-pinned-shadow-checks` nightly, owners: eng-platform/eng-sre, alerts to #eng-platform on regression.
nisha_r: Next steps: ben/oli split PRs (routing + telemetry), UI mock for console copy, legal/billing confirm messaging. Ping here with blockers. :thumbsup:
